QuestInfo.name: Cold Flame
QuestInfo.1: I found an altar within a deep sea cavern that was emitting cold energy. If I start a cold fire and throw in the black book, I should find out more about the content inside--but what to do after? Perhaps taking the new book to #b#p2060100##k will yield answers. \n\n#i4161017##t4161017# #b#c4161017# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: The book's identity has been revealed. It was #bCaron's Note#k! One journey ends as another begins...now to find out more!

0.0: This is #t4001108#. You can make the cold fire with this. Now let me ask a question again. Do you still want to know about this book?

yes.0: Ok...don't forget:You can make the cold fire only on the #bcold altar#k, which is deep inside of the sea... Make a cold fire with #t4001108#, and burn the book with it to reveal its contents.
yes.1: Go to the #bcave where the cold energy emerges from the deep sea#k. You will find what you were looking for there. Where is the cave? Do I have to tell you? If you really want it, you have to find it by yourself even if you have to search the entire ocean floor for it.

no.0: You don't want it? What, are you afraid now? Don't get cold feet...hahaha!

1.0: How do you feel...? Have you been to the cold altar? Good. You made the cold fire. I know. I can smell it on you.

yes.0: Now, let's see what this book is about...Ah ha! It's #b#t4161017##k. I have heard about Caron. Let me keep reading...

item.0: Throw the book in the cold altar and cold fire. Don't come back until you get to know what the book is.

lost.0: What? You lost #t4001108#? Don't you want to know about #t4001107#? I'll help you this time, but be more careful in the future!
